name: Fantasy: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Fantasy look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, epic fantasy concept painting, painterly brushwork, ornate hand-crafted armour and cloth, ancient architecture with real scale, golden light through mist, rich jewel-tone palette, volumetric god rays, atmospheric depth
negative_prompt: modern clothing, guns, cars, sci-fi technology, photographic snapshot look, text, watermark
